To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have designed and synthesized a novel organic cathode material based on covalent triazinic framework and reduced graphene oxide (CTF-rGO) composite with excellent capacity and stability for lithium-ion battery applications.
a rational strategy focusing the optimal composition of CTFs with carbon-based materials was delineated.

a rational strategy focusing upon the optimal composition of porous covalent triazene-based framework (CTF) with carbon-based material is delineated to achieve high-performance organic cathodes for lithium ion battery.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the rational design and development of a high-performance organic lithium ion battery cathodic material.
the rational design and fabrication of porous CTF-rGO composites as advanced lithium ion battery cathodic materials.
the design of porous covalent triazines-based framework composites for use as organic high-performance cathodes for lithium ion batteries.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a rational design of porous CTF-rGO composites with a tailored structure and composition is a highly effective approach to develop a new generation of high-performance organic cathodes.
the rational design of CTF composites with carbon materials of varied dimensions is a promising approach toward high performance organic lithium ion battery cathodic materials.

the CTF-rGO composites are a new generation of advanced lithium ion battery cathodal materials that could be used as an emerging alternative to the inorganic materials that have dominated the industry.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a new type of organic cathode materials with high capacity, excellent cycling stability, and rate performances.
a rational design strategy for the development of organic high-performance cathodes for lithium ion batteries was proposed.
we have designed a new cathode for lithium ion batteries.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the rational design and construction of porous CTF composites with a tailored pore structure can be a viable strategy for the development of high-performance organic cathode materials.
a rational design of porous CTFs as advanced organic lithium ion battery catholes is a promising strategy for resolving the current bottleneck hampered the development of inorganic counterparts.

a rational strategy for designing organic cathode composites is a promising route to achieve the goal of high energy density, high power density, long cycle life, and low cost for next-generation organic cathodes.
